name: Orientation Caravan
mood: An invented working migration resolves into crisp false-colour orientation grains.
credits: Glaze original built-in image_gen artwork and authored native identity. Fictional orientation-map world, not measured microscopy.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. GLAZE ORIENTATION CARAVAN. An invented migration of tangible functional fauna seen as a fictional ELECTRON BACKSCATTER DIFFRACTION ORIENTATION MAP. Image language: flat, sharply segmented POLYCRYSTALLINE GRAINS. Each irregular angular interlocking grain is ONE uniform saturated orientation colour: primary cobalt, carmine red, emerald green, hot fuchsia, cyan or acid yellow. Unequal grain sizes, long grains following limbs, little grains at joints, thin charcoal BLACK grain-boundary seams and occasional three-way junctions. Crisp oblique crystallographic twin bands cross a FEW grains, and tiny stepped detector pixels are just visible along some boundaries. The colour is a false-colour measurement signal, never a material surface. The whole recognizable subject silhouette is packed with hundreds of adjacent coloured grains, with NO shading, gradients, relief, highlights or volumetric modelling. Anatomy/working joints read through silhouette and negative gaps, not a black contour drawing laid over the map. Dense orientation segmentation remains visible at thumbnail size. Not a physical mosaic, stained glass, enamel, gemstones, bismuth, crystal sculpture, origami, low-poly3D model, paint, print, paper craft, contour map, terrain cartography, smooth rainbow interference, thermal field, fluorescent fibres, glowing rim, particle cloud or radiograph. Fictional artistic orientation map, not a real measured microscopy dataset. No text, grain numbers, scale bars, axes, orientation legends, labels, clock faces, readings, graphs, logos or watermark.
